messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearskylabs.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@clearskylabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BYO key handoff + SSO audit logging — triage and owners

Hi Tom / Sara —

Thanks for the call this morning. We captured two top asks from ClearSky that need quick triage so we can scope a pilot:

- BYOK/KMS handoff: you need a documented key import/rotation flow for initial private deployment + a sample policy for HSM/KMS key material provenance.
- SSO / audit logging: ClearSky requires per-user SSO session attribution in audit logs (mapping SAML subject to request token) and a 90-day immutable audit snapshot.

Attached I’ve dropped a small sample of current audit logs and an internal draft BYOK policy so we can point to what changes are required. See attachments.

Asking internal owners to triage and propose next steps:
- Marissa — product: what product work is needed (API surface, UI for key upload, retention knobs)?
- Jonas — security: what evidence we can provide now versus needs engineering changes?
- Priyom — infra/ops: any infra-level blockers for immutable 90-day snapshots and SAML-to-token mapping?

Concrete next steps I'm hoping for by EOD Wednesday 8/11: a short bulleted plan (owner, work estimate, gating risk). I’ll share back to ClearSky with a mutually agreed timeline.

Thanks —
Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: logs_sample_202606.zip (csv+json), byok_key_policy_draft.pdf (internal draft)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BYO key handoff + SSO audit logging — triage and owners

Thanks Alex — quick product readout:

Short answer: doable, but three distinct pieces of work.

1) BYOK UX/API (MVP):
   - API endpoint for key upload + status (1 sprint)
   - Console flow for key metadata and rotation schedule (1 sprint parallel)
   - Gate: requires KMS/HSM client lib on private runtime (ops to confirm)

2) Audit log identity binding (product + infra):
   - Emit SAML subject and internal token mapping in the structured audit log (adds two new fields)
   - Backfill story: we can add fields prospectively; historical mapping requires a migration (costly)

3) Retention & immutable snapshot:
   - Retention config UI (30/60/90) + an immutable export job that writes signed snapshots to object storage (2 sprints)
   - Gate: needs signed export / notarization to meet customer legal ask (security to advise)

I recommend we propose a staged pilot: BYOK API + identity-bound logs (phase 1), retention snapshots gated behind signed export (phase 2).

Marissa
Product Lead — Security & Compliance
marissa@redwood.com

Subject: Re: BYO key handoff + SSO audit logging — triage and owners

Alex / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple clarifications from our side: we want to run a 6-week pilot that proves (A) customer-managed keys can be used for encryption at rest in the inference path, and (B) our security/compliance team can reconcile user SSO sessions to individual inference requests for audit.

Detailed asks:
- For BYOK: can you provide the exact x509 / key envelope formats you accept for import? Also a sample KMS policy we can pre-configure in our HSM to allow the import step.
- For logs: we need request-level logs that include (timestamp, request-id, model-id, redwood-internal-token-id, saml:subject). If internal tokens are ephemeral, we need a durable mapping table export once/day.
- Evidence: sample signed 7-day snapshot first (we can expand to 90 if pilot looks good).

We can share a Pre-PO if we get a clear pilot statement of work + simple acceptance criteria.

Thanks —
Tom Reynolds
Head of Security Engineering, ClearSky Labs
Tom.Reynolds@clearskylabs.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BYO key handoff + SSO audit logging — triage and owners

Looping back with security/ops decisions and a minimal execution plan:

- BYOK key format: we support PKCS#12 or PKCS#8 wrapped in CMS envelope; Priyom, please confirm client lib readiness for HSM import by EOD Thu (8/12). I’ve attached a short spec snippet to the internal runbook.
- SAML-to-token mapping: we will add a stable token_id field in the audit record and run a nightly export that writes a compressed, signed CSV mapping token_id -> saml_subject -> timestamp. This satisfies the durable mapping ask without keeping long-lived tokens.
- Signed snapshots: Security will produce a signed 7-day snapshot proof this week for ClearSky. If pilot acceptance criteria are met, we’ll scale to automated 90-day immutable exports (design doc required).

Action items / owners:
- Priyom: validate HSM import client lib and ETA (EOD 8/12).
- Marissa: scope the BYOK upload API and SSO fields (estimates in story cards by Wed 8/11).
- Alex: confirm pilot SOW + acceptance criteria back to ClearSky (I can help with technical wording).

Risks: cross-region storage for snapshots may add compliance requirements for ClearSky; legal should confirm. Also need to confirm whether the pilot requires a production cryptographic review (likely yes).

I’ll draft a short technical appendix for the pilot that we can attach to the SOW.

Jonas
Head of Security Engineering
jonas@redwood.com
